prompt: A vintage travel-style poster of a giant yellow hugging-face emoji balloon floating over a night city, bold headline text "TRENDING THIS WEEK" at the top
upsampled: Vintage travel-style poster illustration with a screen-printed mid-century finish, limited palette of mustard yellow, deep navy, faded teal, coral red, and warm cream, with visible paper grain, worn ink edges, and minor registration offsets. Across the top, a cream banner carries the bold uppercase headline "TRENDING THIS WEEK" in large condensed navy sans-serif letters, centered above a thin coral rule. Below the headline, a giant yellow hugging-face emoji balloon floats in the upper center over a night city. The spherical balloon has two oval black eyes, a wide open smile, and two thick black arms wrapped around its face. A small tied neck and a long cream string descend from the balloon toward the skyline. Behind it, a dark indigo sky fills the upper half with scattered cream stars, a pale crescent moon, and horizontal bands of muted blue cloud. In the lower half, a dense city spreads across the poster in layered silhouettes: dark teal skyscrapers, narrow apartment towers, rooftop antennas, and rows of coral and yellow illuminated windows. A winding river reflects broken strips of light between the buildings, while a bridge crosses the foreground beneath the balloon. Small cars form cream and red marks along the streets, and a Ferris wheel rises near the lower right. The composition uses simplified geometric shapes, coarse halftone shading, rough ink texture, and a narrow cream border with rounded corners.
